mapper.select: SELECT f.file_id AS fileId, f.file_name AS fileName, f.file_type AS fileType, LEFT(f.file_text, #{maxLength}) AS fileText, CHAR_LENGTH(f.file_text) AS textLength FROM data_file_status f WHERE f.file_id = #{fileId} AND f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND f.del_flag = '0'

SELECT v.id AS sourceId, 'CNV' AS sourceType, v.file_id AS fileId, v.gene AS gene, v.variant AS variant, v.ori_variant AS oriVariant, v.copy_num AS copyNum, v.chr AS chromosome, v.start AS position, v.is_reported AS isReported, v.filtered_rationale AS filteredRationale, v.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM file_CNV v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id
SELECT v.id AS sourceId, 'FUSION' AS sourceType, v.file_id AS fileId, v.gene AS gene, v.gene1 AS gene1, v.gene2 AS gene2, v.variant AS variant, v.ori_variant AS oriVariant, v.tag AS tag, v.freq AS mutFreq, v.depth AS mutDepth, v.fusion_reads AS fusionReads, v.check_result AS checkResult, v.is_reported AS isReported, v.filtered_rationale AS filteredRationale, v.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM file_Fusion v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id
SELECT v.id AS sourceId, 'CR_ALL' AS sourceType, v.file_id AS fileId, v.gene AS gene, v.variant AS variant, v.ori_variant AS oriVariant, v.transcript_id AS transcript, v.exon AS exon, v.exonic_func AS mutationType, v.chgvs AS chgvs, v.phgvs AS phgvs, v.zygosity AS homHet, v.clnsig AS clinicalSignificance, v.chr AS chromosome, v.pos AS position, v.depth AS totalDepth, v.is_reported AS isReported, v.filtered_rationale AS filteredRationale, v.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM file_CR_ALL v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id
SELECT v.id AS sourceId, 'SNP_INDEL' AS sourceType, v.file_id AS fileId, v.gene AS gene, v.variant AS variant, v.ori_variant AS oriVariant, v.transcript AS transcript, v.exon AS exon, v.exonic_func_known_gene AS mutationType, v.chr AS chromosome, v.start AS position, v.hom_het AS homHet, v.mut_freq AS mutFreq, v.mut_depth AS mutDepth, v.total_depth AS totalDepth, v.is_reported AS isReported, v.filtered_rationale AS filteredRationale, v.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM file_Somatic_SNV_Indel v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id
WHERE f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND v.del_flag = '0' AND f.del_flag = '0'
AND v.gene LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.gene}, '%')
AND v.is_reported = #{query.isReported}
ORDER BY v.id ASC

choose.when: UPDATE file_CNV v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id SET v.is_reported = #{isReported}, v.filtered_rationale = #{filteredRationale}, v.reviewed_by = #{operatorId}, v.reviewed_at = NOW(), v.update_by = #{operatorId}, v.update_time = NOW() WHERE v.id = #{sourceId} AND f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND v.del_flag = '0'

UPDATE file_Fusion v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id SET v.is_reported = #{isReported}, v.filtered_rationale = #{filteredRationale}, v.reviewed_by = #{operatorId}, v.reviewed_at = NOW(), v.update_by = #{operatorId}, v.update_time = NOW() WHERE v.id = #{sourceId} AND f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND v.del_flag = '0'

UPDATE file_CR_ALL v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id SET v.is_reported = #{isReported}, v.filtered_rationale = #{filteredRationale}, v.reviewed_by = #{operatorId}, v.reviewed_at = NOW(), v.update_by = #{operatorId}, v.update_time = NOW() WHERE v.id = #{sourceId} AND f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND v.del_flag = '0'
choose.otherwise: UPDATE file_Somatic_SNV_Indel v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id SET v.is_reported = #{isReported}, v.filtered_rationale = #{filteredRationale}, v.reviewed_by = #{operatorId}, v.reviewed_at = NOW(), v.update_by = #{operatorId}, v.update_time = NOW() WHERE v.id = #{sourceId} AND f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND v.del_flag = '0'

mapper.select: SELECT d.analysis_id AS analysisId, d.analysis_date AS analysisDate, d.subbarcode AS subbarcode, d.barcode AS barcode, d.product AS product, d.product_id AS productId, d.analyzer AS analyzer FROM analysis_data d WHERE d.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND d.del_flag = '0'
